text.content: Pioneer Square · Abel Thornquist's domain · Map: yes

The guided tours cover three blocks of the Seattle Underground. This isn't that. Past an iron door that appears on no blueprint, the sidewalks of 1889 run on beneath the ground, with boarded-up storefronts, hand-painted signs, and violet glass skylights that let a dirty light down from the street above. It smells of mold, of damp, and, every so often, of server ozone. A network cable climbs along the ceiling like a vine.

Layout: the Undermarket (stalls trading in information and favors), Thornquist's office in an old barbershop, Ezra's server nest (@UUID[JournalEntry.PBJeE9T9n0BjB6ag]{Ezra “Static” Lund}), and the thin-bloods' haven in an old coal storeroom.

Backgrounds: Haven 4 (Thornquist), Haven 2 (Ezra).

Scenes: @UUID[JournalEntry.5hwXPdn0tUJ3NaKZ.JournalEntryPage.lM1EiE1FoXMkf3Uo]{A1-E04 · Everything Sells Below}. It's also the natural place for @UUID[JournalEntry.x7rVnQfKbb3HdbG5.JournalEntryPage.2fax8pORxdPqKspO]{LOR-02 · The Seattle Underground}.

The Rules Below: no fighting in the Market, everything has a price, and nobody asks about anybody's face.
